title: Adopt hiring.txt
subtitle: Publish your company's hiring.txt in three simple steps. Protect your brand and your candidates.

step1.title: Generate Your File
step1.desc: Use our generator to create a valid hiring.txt file. Fill in your canonical domains, official recruiting channels, application URLs, and Never commitments.

step2.title: Deploy to Your Domain
step2.desc: Place the file at /.well-known/hiring.txt on your canonical domain. It must be served over HTTPS with a valid TLS certificate.
step2.apacheConfig:
# .htaccess or httpd.conf
<Files "hiring.txt">
  Header set Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*"
  Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=86400"
</Files>
step2.staticHostConfig:
# Netlify: public/_headers
/.well-known/hiring.txt
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400

# Cloudflare Pages: _headers (same syntax)
# Vercel: vercel.json headers array

step3.title: Verify & Announce
step3.desc: Test your deployment using our verifier, then announce your adoption.
step3.check4: Expires date is in the future
step3.check5: File passes Tier 0 validation (use our verifier)
step3.announce: Consider announcing your adoption on LinkedIn, your careers page, and in recruiter communications. This builds trust with candidates.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.rule1: Review and update before the Expires date
maintenance.rule2: Update when recruiting channels or domains change
maintenance.rule3: Update when onboarding new authorized recruiters
maintenance.rule4: The generator auto-sets Last-Updated — re-generate when updating

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What if our server doesn't support CORS?
faq.a1: The web verifier requires CORS to fetch your file. Without it, candidates can use the browser extension (coming soon) or manually check the file. We strongly recommend configuring CORS — it's a single header.
faq.q2: Can we host it on a subdomain?
faq.a2: The file should be on your canonical domain (e.g., acme.com, not careers.acme.com), because verifiers resolve from the email sender's domain. List subdomains in Canonical-Domains.
faq.a3: Whenever your recruiting channels, authorized recruiters, or policies change. At minimum, before the Expires date. We recommend setting Expires to 6-12 months out.
faq.a4: Yes, forever. hiring.txt is an open protocol. HireGuard's tools are open source. There is no paid tier.
